title: Opening Project Works on a Move Between Cafe Service Models
content:
## Settlement agreed for opening project works

Where the opening project fee already invoiced on the contract falls below the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from and the cafe has been serving for more than twenty-four months, the whole difference between the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from and the opening project fee already invoiced, rounded to the nearest cent, is settled with the change. Where the opening project fee already invoiced on the contract falls below the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from and the cafe has been serving for twenty-four months or less, half the difference between the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from and the opening project fee already invoiced, rounded to the nearest cent, is settled with the change. Where the opening project fee already invoiced is not below the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from, nothing is settled for opening project works.

## The two readings the term turns on

The first reading is the opening project fee already invoiced on the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract, taken as the amount the client has been billed for the works that opened the cafe counter. The second is the length of service, being the months the cafe has been serving. A cafe that has been serving for more than 24 months stands on the whole difference term; a cafe that has been serving for 24 months, and one that has been serving for fewer, stands on the half difference term.

Where the first reading is not below the opening project fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from, the length of service is not reached at all and nothing is settled for opening project works.

## Illustration on hypothetical amounts

Take a hypothetical contract on which the opening project fee printed against the service model it is moving from is 9400.00 USD and the opening project fee already invoiced is 6150.00 USD. The invoiced amount falls below the printed amount and the difference between them is 3250.00 USD.

Had that hypothetical cafe been serving for 31 months, the whole difference, rounded to the nearest cent, is settled with the change, being 3250.00 USD. Had the same hypothetical cafe been serving for 19 months, half that same difference, rounded to the nearest cent, is settled with the change, being 1625.00 USD. Had the opening project fee already invoiced on that hypothetical contract instead been 9400.00 USD, or any amount above it, the invoiced amount would not be below the printed amount and nothing would be settled for opening project works, whatever the length of service.
